# SutraKey / Sutra Key (सूत्र) — Shift + Select Radial Media & Document Downloader for macOS

> SutraKey (also commonly searched and known as Sutra Key) is an open-source, 100% on-device macOS productivity utility engineered in Swift 6.0 by Aritro Saha. It connects mouse text selection directly to media downloads and clean PDF conversions: hold Shift and select any URL across macOS to summon a zero-latency, liquid frosted-glass radial pie menu directly around your cursor.

## Key Capabilities

1. **Shift + Select Radial Menu**:
   - Spawns a frameless, non-activating liquid frosted-glass radial wheel directly centered under your cursor.
   - Strict modifier exclusivity bitwise guard: ignores selections if Command, Option, or Control are held, preventing system shortcut conflicts.
   - 28pt center dead-zone for instant flick-cancellation.
2. **Four Native Action Slices**:
   - **Video**: Downloads top resolution (4K/1080p 60fps) with audio streams merged to MP4 via `yt-dlp` and `ffmpeg`.
   - **Audio**: Extracts 320kbps MP3 or lossless M4A with embedded album art and ID3 metadata tags.
   - **Subtitles**: Direct extraction of SRT or VTT closed captions in user-configured languages.
   - **Web to PDF**: Headless vector printing powered by Apple WebKit (`WKWebView`) with active layout stabilization and preserved hyperlinks.
3. **Keychain-Powered Browser Authentication**:
   - One-click Keychain decryption for Brave, Chrome, Safari, Edge, and Arc sessions.
   - Direct support for authenticated feeds like Instagram Stories, private posts, and member-only YouTube streams.
4. **Ephemeral Menu Bar Presence**:
   - 0% idle CPU and invisible menu bar state until a download is queued.
   - Live transfer rate (MB/s), circular progress indicator, and one-click task cancellation.

---

## Installation Quickstart

### Homebrew Cask (Recommended)
```bash
brew install --cask halcyon-past/tap/sutrakey
```
Or:
```bash
brew tap halcyon-past/tap
brew install --cask sutrakey
```

### Direct Download
- [SutraKey.dmg (Universal Apple Silicon & Intel)](https://github.com/halcyon-past/SutraKey/releases/latest/download/SutraKey.dmg)
- [SutraKey.zip (In-Place Auto-Updater)](https://github.com/halcyon-past/SutraKey/releases/latest/download/SutraKey.zip)

### Build from Source (Swift 6)
```bash
git clone https://github.com/halcyon-past/SutraKey.git
cd SutraKey
./Scripts/package_and_install.sh
```
